item.title: Mass. primary features Markey vs. Moulton and more key races
item.description: Massachusetts is holding its 2026 primary election on Tuesday, with the ballot featuring a Senate race between Ed Markey and Seth Moulton.

item.title: What to expect from new Apple CEO John Ternus as Tim Cook steps down
item.description: John Ternus officially took over for Tim Cook as Apple CEO on Tuesday, becoming the tech giant's first new leader in 15 years. CBS News' Jo Ling Kent reports and CBS News contributor Patrick McGee breaks down what to expect.

item.title: Charlie Kirk's alleged killer will stand trial for aggravated murder
item.description: Judge Tony Graf said prosecutors have enough evidence against Tyler Robinson to put the 23-year-old on trial on a charge that could see him face the death penalty.

item.title: Duane Davis' attorney doesn't believe jury considered all evidence before Tupac murder conviction
item.description: Michael Sanft, Duane "Keefe D" Davis' defense attorney, joins "The Daily Report" to discuss his client's conviction for the 1996 murder of Tupac Shakur and shares his concerns about the jury's "preconceived notions."

item.title: Marine veteran weighs in on Trump's military strategy against Iran as strikes continue
item.description: CBS News contributor Elliot Ackerman, a Marine Corps veteran, breaks down President Trump's military strategy as the U.S. launches new strikes over Iran's alleged interference with the passage of ships in the Strait of Hormuz.

item.title: House censures Rep. Chuck Edwards over "inappropriate conduct" toward aides
item.description: The House on Tuesday voted to censure Republican Rep. Chuck Edwards of North Carolina over "inappropriate conduct" toward aides. Edwards denies the allegations.

item.title: Massachusetts Senate primary revolving around age, desire for generational change
item.description: Sen. Ed Markey, 80, is set to face 47-year-old Rep. Seth Moulton in Massachusetts on Tuesday in a Democratic primary for Senate set to be marked by discussions of age and generational change. CBS News' political director Fin Gómez has more.

item.title: Tony Romo pleads no contest to Wisconsin operating while intoxicated charge
item.description: The longtime Dallas Cowboys quarterback and CBS Sports football analyst said he came to rely on alcohol to get off pain medications after multiple back surgeries.

item.title: Officer charged with manslaughter after fatally shooting student who knocked on the wrong door
item.description: A 22-year-old college baseball player was gunned down in Pennsylvania last week after knocking on the wrong door. On Tuesday, a 58-year-old police corporal was charged with manslaughter. Tom Hanson reports.

item.title: Jordan intercepts Iranian missiles as Trump vows more strikes on Iran
item.description: U.S. forces launched new strikes Tuesday on targets connected to Iran's Revolutionary Guard, marking another round of attacks this week as the U.S. and Iran return to hostilities.

item.title: Woman gets potential shark bite off Martha's Vineyard, in the same town "Jaws" was filmed
item.description: No one spotted a shark on Monday off the coast of Martha's Vineyard, in the very same town where "Jaws" was filmed. But a woman emerged from the ocean there with what officials say looked like a shark bite. Lilia Luciano reports.

item.title: Tony Romo apologizes after pleading no contest to OWI: "None of this is an excuse"
item.description: Former Dallas Cowboys quarterback Tony Romo pleaded no contest on Tuesday to a civil charge of operating while intoxicated. He explained how football injuries led to painkillers and eventually alcohol, but also took responsibility for what he called failures. Mark Strassmann reports.

item.title: Why Army Secretary Dan Driscoll is resigning now
item.description: U.S. Army Secretary Dan Driscoll submitted his resignation Monday after months of friction with Secretary of Defense Pete Hegseth. CBS News' Eleanor Watson has more.

item.title: Tit-for-tat strikes with Iran as lawmakers react to Dan Driscoll's resignation
item.description: U.S. forces struck Iran on Tuesday, the second series of attacks in three days. Meanwhile, lawmakers reacted to the resignation of U.S. Army Secretary Dan Driscoll, part of a wave of about two dozen early departures among America's generals, admirals and top military brass. Weijia Jiang reports.

item.title: Crockett says she hasn't talked strategy with Talarico recently: "I trust that he has a plan"
item.description: Democratic Rep. Jasmine Crockett of Texas has said she has no plans to campaign with Senate candidate James Talarico, whom she ran against in the state's primary. Crockett joins "The Takeout" to explain what she'll be doing instead.

item.title: Tropical Storm Edouard makes landfall along Gulf Coast
item.description: Tropical Storm Edouard made landfall in Louisiana on Tuesday afternoon, and is also forecast to bring heavy rain to Texas, the National Hurricane Center said.

item.title: Judge sends Lindsay Clancy jury back for deliberations after they could not reach a verdict
item.description: The chance of a mistrial in the Lindsay Clancy case grew on Tuesday after the jury said they were unable to reach a unanimous verdict and the judge sent them back to continue deliberating. Clancy is on trial for the killing of her three children. Shanelle Kaul reports from the Massachusetts courthouse and Caroline Polisi has more.

item.title: Trump says "biggest attack of them all" is "waiting in the wings" for Iran as U.S. strikes again
item.description: President Trump launched new attacks against Iran Tuesday for allegedly trying to install sea mines in the Strait of Hormuz. Mr. Trump warned that the worse is still to come if Iran retaliates. CBS News' Natalie Brand has more.

item.title: Tropical Storm Edouard makes landfall, drenching parts of Texas and Louisiana
item.description: Tropical Storm Edouard drenched parts of Texas and Louisiana on Tuesday. The threat intensified very quickly after developing late Monday night out in the Gulf. Jason Allen reports from Texas and Rob Marciano has the forecast.

item.title: House censures Rep. Chuck Edwards over "inappropriate conduct" toward aides
item.description: The House Ethics Committee detailed the North Carolina Republican's "unprofessional and inappropriate conduct" toward two young women who worked for him.

item.title: Former Border Patrol Commander Gregory Bovino was under investigation when he retired, records show
item.description: Former Border Patrol Commander Gregory Bovino was formally notified he was under an internal investigation just 16 days before he announced his retirement plans, records show. CBS News' homeland security correspondent Nicole Sganga breaks down what we know.

item.title: Jasmine Crockett accuses Texas GOP of wanting to slash poll sites because of high Democratic turnout
item.description: Local officials in Texas are voting on whether to cut the number of polling sites in the state's third-largest county. Officials say it would get rid of low-turnout sites, while Democrats argue it's voter suppression. Democratic Rep. Jasmine Crockett of Texas joins with her perspective.

item.title: House adopts resolution condemning socialism, with 8 Democrats joining Republicans
item.description: GOP leaders scheduled the vote after Democratic primary voters embraced a number of democratic socialist candidates.

item.title: Generational change at center of Massachusetts primary between Moulton, Markey
item.description: Voters in Massachusetts are at the polls on Tuesday for the state's primary elections -- a notable race: Rep. Seth Moulton's Democratic primary challenge to 80-year-old Sen. Ed Markey. Rolling Stone politics reporter Nikki Ramirez and Politico national politics reporter Alec Hernandez join to discuss.

item.title: Lindsay Clancy trial jury deadlocked, leaves for day without verdict
item.description: The jury in Lindsay Clancy's murder trial told the judge Tuesday morning they are deadlocked, and left a Massachusetts courtroom hours later without reaching a verdict.

item.title: Criminal defense attorney on how likely mistrial is in Lindsay Clancy case
item.description: The jury in Lindsay Clancy's murder trial informed the judge Tuesday that they were unable to come to a unanimous verdict. The judge has asked them to continue deliberating, which they'll do for a fifth day on Wednesday. CBS News' Shanelle Kaul reports and criminal defense attorney Elyse Hershon joins "The Daily Report" to offer analysis.

item.title: How long could the Lindsay Clancy jury remain deadlocked?
item.description: Karen Read's first trial ended with a hung jury. Here's a look at how those deliberations played out as the Lindsay Clancy jury says it is deadlocked.

item.title: Tropical Storm Edouard makes landfall near Texas-Louisiana border
item.description: Tropical Storm Edouard made landfall Tuesday near Johnson Bayou, Louisiana, close to the border with Texas. CBS News' Jason Allen reports on the conditions.

item.title: Ex-Border Patrol commander Bovino was under investigation when he retired
item.description: CBP informed Gregory Bovino in an email on March 2 that the agency was "conducting an official Inquiry into allegations of misconduct reported to CBP." He initiated retirement 16 days later.

item.title: 2 dead, at least 1 missing after Grand Canyon hit by flash floods
item.description: Violent flash floods hit the Grand Canyon's Bright Angel Canyon and Phantom Ranch area, causing "extensive damage" to the park's water infrastructure.
